provenance.paper_title: GCAgent: Graph-Centric Episodic Memory for Long Video Agents

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Schematic and narrative episodic memories encode entities, events, and causal-temporal relations.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Narrative memory summarizes episodes for later perception-action-reflection reasoning.
Trajectory observations are consolidated into narrative episodes. For GCAgent, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of schematic episodic memory.
During operation, GCAgent applies LLM-mediated memory editing to schematic episodic memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (schematic episodic memory) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, LLM-mediated memory editing; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
